body:
~/wotan-deploy.sh run. Live-verified against wotan.okemily.com/friends.html directly (not just the filesystem copy): zero password fields, 'Sign in with IDUNA' link present, sso-exchange fetch call present. Full redirect chain confirmed: https://iam.okemily.com/?redirect_uri=https://wotan.okemily.com/friends.html returns a clean 200 (the real IDUNA login page, not a broken redirect). Closes the founder's 'make it work for Friends and Duels' ask.

⚓ ☃
title: friends.html deployed live with working IDUNA SSO + DEADWEIGHT token exchange (Apple #20760 follow-through)
